messages:
maria: quick FYI - canary for saturn-8b-x (q4f16) shows token-repeat on long prompts + ~30% tail latency bump vs main. failing eval run attached.

ajay: which eval set? overall p95? link?

maria: eval: eval-suite/v1/long_context.json run id `run_2024-06-12_09`. p95 went 210ms -> 275ms. p50 stable. repeat rate up on ~3% of prompts.

kim: any change to batching or KV config for canary?

maria: no batching change. quant config: q4f16 + kernel: fused-attn-opt-1. stack trace in logs:
```
WARN kvcache: mismatch seq 1024 vs 1008
TRACE tokengen: repeated token "the" 12x
```

ops-bot: ALERT: canary/saturn-8b-x latency_slo_breach at 2024-06-12T09:12:44Z - https://ci/reports/123

lia: if kvcache lengths mismatch we may be evicting cache or replaying. did we flip KV-serialize option in runtime?

dan: repro steps I used locally:
```
./run_inference --model saturn-8b-x --quant q4f16 --prompt-file tests/long_prompts.txt --batch 1 --use-fused-attn
```
I can reproduce on my dev with same perf bump.

ajay: can you grab `perf top` and `strace -c` during repro? also heap/alloc profile.

maria: will roll back canary to baseline (q8_0) now, re-run evals and collect traces. canary rollback initiated.

deploy-bot: canary rollback started for saturn-8b-x by maria at 2024-06-12T09:18:00Z

maria: post-rollback p95 reverted to 212ms. opening issue: GH #4567 with logs + repro steps.

kim: adding follow-ups: add KV-serialize regression test, add token-repeat test to eval-suite, and run full quant sweep for q4 variants.

lia: also add a sanity assert in runtime for KV cache length mismatch to fail fast.

maria: thanks all — will attach flamegraphs and link GH issue.
